result.title: MedicalDPO: Multi-Objective Direct Preference Optimization for CT to PET Translation
result.summary: CT-to-PET synthesis estimates functional PET images from anatomical CT scans for auxiliary analysis, representation pretraining, and missing-modality completion. Brownian Bridge diffusion models can produce multiple PET candidates of different quality under the same CT condition, exposing an intra-condition quality hierarchy. Candidate quality spans complementary spatial, structural, and intensity dimensions, while DPO-only fine-tuning may compromise absolute synthesis fidelity. We propose MedicalDPO which converts this hierarchy into preference supervision automatically constructed from paired CT-PET training data. Multiple candidates are ranked across the three fidelity dimensions, and strict cross-metric verification retains preferred-rejected pairs with consistent quality separation. Relative denoising-error preference optimization is jointly trained with the original Brownian Bridge objective to anchor the pretrained CT-to-PET mapping, while condition-balanced multi-pair rotation distributes preference supervision across CT conditions. Experiments on BBDM and CPDM show improvements across LPIPS, MAE, SSIM, and PSNR. Further analyses demonstrate metric complementarity and clear pair separation, while ablations show that the original training objective prevents the substantial degradation caused by DPO-only fine-tuning.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MedicalDPO，在 CT→PET 图像合成中利用配对数据自动构造多维保真度偏好对，将相对去噪误差偏好优化与原始 Brownian Bridge 目标联合训练，并在多个 CT 条件下平衡轮换偏好监督。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「同条件多候选排序＋跨指标严格筛选偏好对＋锚定原训练目标」的监督构造方式，可能为 latent 推理轨迹的偏好式训练与避免基础能力退化提供可供核查的线索，但本身不涉及推理状态或证据使用。
